benighted.en: The reformers saw themselves as bringing science to a benighted countryside.
benighted.zh: 改革者们自视为把科学带给愚昧乡村的人。

bestow.en: The university will bestow an honorary degree on the Nobel laureate this spring.
bestow.zh: 这所大学将于今年春天向这位诺贝尔奖得主授予荣誉学位。

bifurcate.en: The trail bifurcates at the old bridge, with one fork climbing the ridge and the other following the river.
bifurcate.zh: 小路在老桥处一分为二：一条攀上山脊，另一条沿河而行。

blunder.en: Admitting the blunder early saved the firm from a far costlier correction later.
blunder.zh: 及早承认这个愚蠢的错误，使公司避免了日后代价高得多的补救。

botch.en: The restoration was so badly botched that the mural lost much of its original detail.
botch.zh: 这次修复被笨拙地弄糟了，壁画失去了大量原有细节。

bourgeoisie.en: The novel satirizes the bourgeoisie of the provincial town, obsessed with status and respectability.
bourgeoisie.zh: 这部小说讽刺了这座外省城市的资产阶级，他们痴迷于地位和体面。

bravado.en: His boastful account of the expedition was pure bravado; he had never left base camp.
bravado.zh: 他对那次探险的夸耀纯属虚张声势——他从未离开过大本营。

broach.en: It took several meetings before anyone dared to broach the subject of layoffs.
broach.zh: 开了好几次会，才有人敢提出裁员这个话题。

buffer.en: A savings account can buffer a family against sudden medical expenses.
buffer.zh: 储蓄账户可以减轻突发医疗开支对一个家庭的冲击。

cacophony.en: From the street below rose a cacophony of horns, shouting vendors, and construction drills.
cacophony.zh: 楼下街道上传来喇叭声、小贩的叫卖声和施工电钻声混杂的刺耳噪音。

calibrate.en: Before the experiment, the team spent two days calibrating every instrument in the lab.
calibrate.zh: 实验开始前，团队花了两天时间校准实验室里的每一台仪器。

candour.en: Her candour about the project's failures won her more respect than any success could have.
candour.zh: 她对项目失败的坦率，为她赢得了比任何成功都多的尊重。

caper.en: The film follows a group of retirees who plan one last jewel caper on the French Riviera.
caper.zh: 这部电影讲述一群退休老人计划在法国里维埃拉干最后一票珠宝劫案的故事。

castigation.en: The editorial reserved its harshest castigation for officials who had ignored the early warnings.
castigation.zh: 这篇社论把最严厉的谴责留给了那些无视早期预警的官员。

categorical.en: The spokesperson issued a categorical denial of all the allegations in the report.
categorical.zh: 发言人对报告中的所有指控予以断然否认。

cavalier.en: His cavalier attitude toward safety procedures eventually cost the company its license.
cavalier.zh: 他对安全规程漫不经心的态度最终使公司丢掉了执照。

certitude.en: She spoke with a certitude that silenced the room, though her evidence was thin.
certitude.zh: 她以一种令全场沉默的笃定口气发言，尽管她的证据并不充分。

charisma.en: The candidate's charisma drew huge crowds, even where his policies were unpopular.
charisma.zh: 这位候选人的个人魅力吸引了大批民众，即便他的政策在当地并不受欢迎。

chasten.en: The humbling defeat chastened the young champion, who returned to training with new discipline.
chasten.zh: 这次丢脸的失败让这位年轻的冠军变得谦逊，他带着新的自律回到了训练场。

chastity.en: Medieval writers often treated chastity as the highest virtue a knight's beloved could possess.
chastity.zh: 中世纪作家常把贞洁视为骑士恋人所能拥有的最高美德。

chicanery.en: The investigation revealed years of financial chicanery hidden behind respectable annual reports.
chicanery.zh: 调查揭露了多年来隐藏在体面年报背后的财务诡计。

circumlocution.en: His reply was a masterpiece of circumlocution, saying in three minutes what needed only a yes or no.
circumlocution.zh: 他的回答堪称绕圈子说话的杰作——只需一个是或否，他却说了三分钟。

clause.en: A single ambiguous clause in the contract led to years of litigation.
clause.zh: 合同中一个含糊的条款导致了多年的诉讼。

coerce.en: The court ruled that the confession had been coerced and could not be admitted as evidence.
coerce.zh: 法院裁定该供述系胁迫所得，不能作为证据采纳。

collegiality.en: The department's collegiality made it easy for junior scholars to share half-formed ideas.
collegiality.zh: 这个院系融洽的合作氛围让年轻学者敢于分享尚未成型的想法。

colloquial.en: The translation preserves the colloquial tone of the original dialogue.
colloquial.zh: 译文保留了原对话的口语化风格。

compassion.en: The nurse treated every patient with the same patience and compassion.
compassion.zh: 这位护士以同样的耐心和同情对待每一位病人。

complimentary.en: The review was so complimentary that the author suspected the critic had missed the book's flaws.
complimentary.zh: 这篇评论满是溢美之词，以至于作者怀疑评论家漏看了书中的缺陷。

compulsory.en: Attendance at the safety briefing is compulsory for all laboratory staff.
compulsory.zh: 所有实验室人员都必须参加安全说明会。

concord.en: After years of rivalry, the two departments finally reached a state of concord over the shared budget.
concord.zh: 多年的对立之后，两个系终于在共同预算问题上达成了一致。

condone.en: The university made clear that it would not condone plagiarism in any form.
condone.zh: 校方明确表示不会容忍任何形式的剽窃。

confess.en: Under gentle questioning, the witness confessed that she had not seen the accident clearly.
confess.zh: 在温和的询问下，证人承认她当时并没有看清事故经过。

conflate.en: The essay carelessly conflates correlation with causation throughout its central argument.
conflate.zh: 这篇文章在其核心论证中始终草率地把相关性混同于因果性。

consort.en: The prince was criticized for consorting with businessmen who had questionable reputations.
consort.zh: 这位王子因与名声可疑的商人交往而受到批评。

constricted.en: Years of budget cuts left the museum with a constricted exhibition schedule.
constricted.zh: 多年的预算削减使博物馆的展览安排大受限制。

controvert.en: New evidence from the dig site controverts the long-accepted account of the city's founding.
controvert.zh: 来自发掘现场的新证据推翻了长期以来被接受的建城史叙述。

contumacious.en: The contumacious witness refused for the third time to answer the committee's questions.
contumacious.zh: 这名藐视权威的证人第三次拒绝回答委员会的问题。

corporeal.en: The philosopher argued that memories, though intangible, depend on corporeal structures in the brain.
corporeal.zh: 这位哲学家认为，记忆虽无形，却依赖于大脑中有形的结构。

coterie.en: A small coterie of loyal assistants controlled all access to the reclusive director.
coterie.zh: 一小群忠诚的助手控制着所有与这位深居简出的导演接触的渠道。

cower.en: The dog cowered in the corner whenever thunder rolled across the valley.
cower.zh: 每当雷声滚过山谷，这条狗就畏缩在角落里。

crabbed.en: The critic complained that the philosopher's crabbed prose obscured rather than clarified his ideas.
crabbed.zh: 评论家抱怨说，这位哲学家晦涩的文字不但没有阐明，反而掩盖了他的思想。

crave.en: After weeks of field rations, the crew craved nothing so much as fresh bread.
crave.zh: 吃了几个星期的野战口粮后，队员们最渴望的就是新鲜面包。

craven.en: Only a craven leader would sacrifice his allies to save his own position.
craven.zh: 只有胆怯的领导者才会牺牲盟友来保住自己的位置。

cronyism.en: The mayor's appointments were widely condemned as cronyism, since nearly every post went to a campaign donor.
cronyism.zh: 市长的任命被广泛谴责为任人唯亲，因为几乎每个职位都给了竞选捐款人。

cyclic.en: The economist argued that the downturn was merely cyclic and did not require structural reform.
cyclic.zh: 这位经济学家认为，这次衰退只是周期性的，不需要结构性改革。

daredevil.en: The daredevil motorcyclist jumped twelve buses before a cheering crowd.
daredevil.zh: 这位胆大包天的摩托车手在欢呼的人群前飞跃了十二辆公交车。

deaden.en: Years of routine work had deadened his curiosity about the subject he once loved.
deaden.zh: 多年的例行工作磨灭了他对这个曾经热爱的学科的好奇心。

deadpan.en: She delivered the absurd excuse with such deadpan seriousness that no one could tell she was joking.
deadpan.zh: 她面无表情地说出那个荒唐的借口，没人看得出她在开玩笑。

decadent.en: The novel portrays a decadent aristocracy drifting from one lavish party to another.
decadent.zh: 这部小说描绘了一个颓废的贵族阶层，在一场又一场奢华宴会之间虚度光阴。

deceit.en: The scheme collapsed when the investors discovered the founder's long record of deceit.
deceit.zh: 当投资者发现创始人长期的欺骗记录后，这个计划土崩瓦解了。

decipherable.en: Only a handful of specialists can read the manuscript, and even they find parts of it barely decipherable.
decipherable.zh: 只有少数专家能读懂这份手稿，就连他们也觉得其中一些部分几乎无法破译。

defensible.en: Her decision to delay publication was defensible given the uncertainty of the data.
defensible.zh: 考虑到数据的不确定性，她推迟发表的决定是可以辩解的。

defray.en: The grant will defray most of the costs of the fieldwork in the Amazon.
defray.zh: 这笔资助将支付亚马逊野外考察的大部分费用。

defunct.en: The factory has been defunct for a decade, its chimneys now home to nesting birds.
defunct.zh: 这家工厂已经停产十年，烟囱如今成了鸟类的巢穴。

delicate.en: The restorer used a delicate brush to clean the centuries-old manuscript.
delicate.zh: 修复师用精细的刷子清理这份数百年前的手稿。

delightful.en: The garden's hidden bench, shaded by jasmine, offered a delightful spot for reading.
delightful.zh: 花园里那张被茉莉遮蔽的隐秘长椅，是个令人愉悦的读书角落。

delimit.en: The treaty clearly delimits the fishing zones of the two coastal nations.
delimit.zh: 该条约明确界定了两个沿海国家的捕鱼区域。

delude.en: He deluded himself into believing that one more gamble would recover all his losses.
delude.zh: 他自欺欺人地相信，再赌一把就能挽回所有损失。

demonize.en: The pamphlet seeks to demonize an entire community for the crimes of a few individuals.
demonize.zh: 这本小册子企图因少数人的罪行而将整个群体妖魔化。

demystify.en: The professor's great gift was her ability to demystify statistics for first-year students.
demystify.zh: 这位教授的过人之处，在于她能为大一学生把统计学讲得明白易懂。

dependable.en: The old truck was not fast, but it was dependable, starting every morning without fail.
dependable.zh: 这辆旧卡车不快，但很可靠，每天早晨都能顺利发动。

derogate.en: The review does more than criticize the book; it openly derogates the author's scholarship.
derogate.zh: 这篇评论不只是批评这本书，而是公然贬低作者的学术水平。

despot.en: The despot tolerated no opposition, filling the prisons with journalists and poets.
despot.zh: 这位独裁者不容任何反对，把记者和诗人关满了监狱。

destined.en: From her first exhibition, critics agreed she was destined to reshape modern sculpture.
destined.zh: 从她的首次展览起，评论家们就一致认为她注定要重塑现代雕塑。

desultory.en: The committee made only desultory efforts to enforce the new rules, and they were soon ignored.
desultory.zh: 委员会只是零散随意地执行新规，很快这些规定就被无视了。

digress.en: Forgive me if I digress for a moment, but this detail matters more than it seems.
digress.zh: 请原谅我稍稍跑题一下，但这个细节比看上去更重要。

dilettante.en: He dabbled in painting as a dilettante, never submitting his work to serious criticism.
dilettante.zh: 他以半吊子的态度涉猎绘画，从不把作品交给严肃的评论。

discord.en: The proposal sowed discord among allies who had campaigned together for a decade.
discord.zh: 这项提议在共同奋斗了十年的盟友之间播下了不和的种子。

discordant.en: The report's conclusions are discordant with nearly every previous study of the species.
discordant.zh: 这份报告的结论与此前几乎所有关于该物种的研究都不一致。

disinformation.en: The government set up a unit to counter disinformation spread during the election.
disinformation.zh: 政府成立了一个专门机构，以应对选举期间散布的假消息。

disown.en: When the scandal broke, his former allies were quick to disown him.
disown.zh: 丑闻爆发时，他昔日的盟友纷纷与他撇清关系。

disquiet.en: The sudden resignation of the chief scientist disquieted the entire research team.
disquiet.zh: 首席科学家的突然辞职让整个研究团队感到不安。

disrepute.en: The once-respected journal fell into disrepute after publishing a series of retracted papers.
disrepute.zh: 这家一度备受尊敬的期刊在发表了一系列被撤回的论文后声名狼藉。

disrupt.en: A single protester managed to disrupt the ceremony for nearly half an hour.
disrupt.zh: 一名抗议者就让仪式中断了将近半个小时。

distress.en: The sailors' distress call was picked up by a passing cargo ship.
distress.zh: 水手的求救信号被一艘路过的货船接收到了。

dogged.en: Her dogged pursuit of the missing files eventually exposed the cover-up.
dogged.zh: 她对失踪文件锲而不舍的追查最终揭露了这起掩盖事件。

duplicitous.en: The duplicitous envoy assured both sides that he supported their claims exclusively.
duplicitous.zh: 这名奸诈的使节向双方都保证自己只支持他们的主张。

effrontery.en: He had the effrontery to demand a bonus after bankrupting the department.
effrontery.zh: 他把部门搞垮之后，竟然还有脸要求奖金。

elastic.en: Demand for luxury goods is highly elastic, falling sharply when incomes decline.
elastic.zh: 奢侈品的需求弹性很大，收入下降时会急剧减少。

elegy.en: The poem is an elegy for the fishing villages emptied by the great migration.
elegy.zh: 这首诗是为大迁徙中空寂的渔村所作的挽歌。

elide.en: The abridged edition elides several chapters that slow the narrative.
elide.zh: 节略版省略了几个拖慢叙事节奏的章节。

elision.en: The elision of the witness's second statement gave a misleading impression of her testimony.
elision.zh: 对证人第二份陈述的删略，使人们对她的证词产生了误导性印象。

elucidate.en: The appendix elucidates the statistical methods used throughout the study.
elucidate.zh: 附录阐明了这项研究通篇使用的统计方法。

enchanting.en: The valley, with its terraced fields and morning mist, was utterly enchanting.
enchanting.zh: 那道山谷有层层梯田和晨雾，迷人极了。

encroachment.en: Residents protested the encroachment of the new highway on the protected wetland.
encroachment.zh: 居民们抗议新高速公路对受保护湿地的侵占。

enjoin.en: The contract enjoins employees from disclosing client data to any third party.
enjoin.zh: 合同禁止员工向任何第三方泄露客户数据。

enthrall.en: The storyteller enthralled the children with tales of shipwrecks and hidden treasure.
enthrall.zh: 讲故事的人用沉船和宝藏的传说把孩子们迷住了。

entice.en: The startup enticed senior engineers away from larger firms with generous stock options.
entice.zh: 这家初创公司以丰厚的股票期权，把资深工程师从大公司吸引了过来。

entreaty.en: Despite her entreaties, the committee refused to reconsider the application.
entreaty.zh: 尽管她再三恳求，委员会仍拒绝重新考虑这份申请。

episodic.en: Rainfall in the region is episodic, arriving in violent bursts separated by long droughts.
episodic.zh: 该地区的降雨是阵发性的，在漫长的干旱之间以猛烈的暴雨形式到来。

equipoise.en: The negotiations ended in a fragile equipoise, with neither side strong enough to impose its terms.
equipoise.zh: 谈判以脆弱的均势告终，双方都无力强加自己的条件。

ersatz.en: The cafe served an ersatz cappuccino made with powdered milk and syrup.
ersatz.zh: 这家咖啡馆供应的是用奶粉和糖浆调制的仿卡布奇诺。

ethos.en: The company's ethos of openness encouraged even interns to challenge senior managers.
ethos.zh: 这家公司开放的理念鼓励连实习生也敢于质疑高层管理者。

etiolate.en: Plants grown in the dark become etiolated, pale and weak from lack of sunlight.
etiolate.zh: 在黑暗中生长的植物会因缺少阳光而变得苍白虚弱。

euphemize.en: The report euphemized the layoffs as a 'strategic realignment of human resources'.
euphemize.zh: 报告把裁员委婉地说成是'人力资源的战略性重组'。

evangelist.en: He became an evangelist for open-source software, preaching its virtues at every conference.
evangelist.zh: 他成了开源软件的狂热布道者，在每个会议上宣讲它的好处。

evocatively.en: The memoir describes the smells of the harbor so evocatively that readers feel they are standing on the docks.
evocatively.zh: 这本回忆录把海港的气味描写得如此生动，让读者仿佛就站在码头上。

exasperate.en: The constant delays exasperated even the most patient members of the committee.
exasperate.zh: 没完没了的拖延把委员会里最有耐心的成员也激怒了。

exhilarating.en: The first solo flight was an exhilarating experience she never forgot.
exhilarating.zh: 第一次独自飞行是一次令她终生难忘的兴奋体验。

exhort.en: The coach exhorted the team to defend every inch of the field in the final minutes.
exhort.zh: 教练强烈要求队员们在最后几分钟守住球场的每一寸。

exhortation.en: The principal's exhortation to 'read more widely' became the graduating class's unofficial motto.
exhortation.zh: 校长那句'更广泛地阅读'的劝勉，成了这届毕业班的非正式座右铭。

explicate.en: In the final lecture, she explicated the poem's most obscure stanza line by line.
explicate.zh: 在最后一讲中，她逐行详细解释了这首诗最难懂的一节。

extemporize.en: When his notes blew off the podium, the senator had to extemporize for ten minutes.
extemporize.zh: 当讲稿被吹下讲台时，这位参议员只好即兴讲了十分钟。

extortionate.en: The landlord charged extortionate rents for apartments that were barely habitable.
extortionate.zh: 这位房东对几乎无法居住的公寓收取高得离谱的租金。

exultant.en: The exultant crowd poured into the streets when the verdict was announced.
exultant.zh: 判决宣布时，狂喜的人群涌上街头。

fabulous.en: The explorer returned with fabulous tales of cities of gold hidden in the jungle.
fabulous.zh: 这位探险家带回了关于丛林中隐藏的黄金之城的离奇故事。

facet.en: The study examines every facet of the city's transportation network.
facet.zh: 这项研究考察了该市交通网络的每一个方面。

facetious.en: His facetious remark about the budget amused the press but irritated the finance minister.
facetious.zh: 他关于预算的那句玩笑话逗乐了记者，却惹恼了财政部长。

falsify.en: The researcher was dismissed for falsifying data in three published papers.
falsify.zh: 这名研究员因在三篇已发表论文中篡改数据而被解雇。

fanfare.en: The policy was announced with great fanfare but quietly abandoned within a year.
fanfare.zh: 这项政策发布时大张旗鼓，却在一年内被悄悄放弃。

farsighted.en: Her farsighted investment in renewable energy paid off a decade later.
farsighted.zh: 她当年对可再生能源的有远见的投资，十年后获得了回报。

felicity.en: The couple's felicity was evident to everyone at the anniversary dinner.
felicity.zh: 这对夫妇的幸福，在纪念日晚宴上对每个人都显而易见。

fiat.en: The minister ruled by fiat, bypassing parliament whenever it suited him.
fiat.zh: 这位部长以命令治国，只要觉得方便就绕开议会。

fixate.en: The media fixated on the scandal while ignoring the broader policy failure.
fixate.zh: 媒体盯着这桩丑闻不放，却忽视了更广泛的政策失败。

foolproof.en: No security system is foolproof, but this one comes closer than most.
foolproof.zh: 没有绝对万无一失的安保系统，但这套比大多数都更接近。

forbid.en: The regulations forbid researchers from sharing raw data outside the consortium.
forbid.zh: 规定禁止研究人员在联盟之外分享原始数据。

foreclose.en: Filing the lawsuit now would foreclose any chance of a negotiated settlement.
foreclose.zh: 现在提起诉讼将排除任何协商和解的可能。

foreordain.en: The outcome of the match was far from foreordained; the underdogs nearly won.
foreordain.zh: 这场比赛的结果远非预先注定——弱队差点赢了。

forerun.en: The harrier foreruns the main flock, scouting the safest route across the marsh.
forerun.zh: 领头的猎犬跑在主队之前，侦察穿越沼泽最安全的路线。

foretell.en: No model could have foretold the speed of the glacier's collapse.
foretell.zh: 没有任何模型能预言这座冰川崩解的速度。

forethink.en: The engineers had not forethought the possibility of a total power failure.
forethink.zh: 工程师们事先没有考虑到全面停电的可能性。

forswear.en: After the scandal, the candidate forswore all donations from the industry.
forswear.zh: 丑闻之后，这位候选人发誓放弃来自该行业的所有捐款。

free-for-all.en: The debate quickly degenerated into a free-for-all, with candidates shouting over one another.
free-for-all.zh: 辩论很快沦为一场混战，候选人们互相吼叫着压过对方。

freewheeling.en: The professor encouraged freewheeling discussion, welcoming even half-formed ideas.
freewheeling.zh: 这位教授鼓励随心所欲的讨论，连未成形的想法也欢迎。

frisson.en: A frisson of excitement ran through the audience as the curtain rose.
frisson.zh: 幕布升起时，一阵兴奋的战栗传遍观众席。

fustian.en: The speech was full of fustian phrases that impressed no one familiar with the facts.
fustian.zh: 这篇演说满是浮夸的辞藻，对了解事实的人毫无说服力。

futurity.en: The poet wrote of futurity as a country whose borders no traveler would ever reach.
futurity.zh: 诗人把未来写成一个任何旅人都无法抵达其边界的国度。

garble.en: The message was so garbled in transmission that its meaning was entirely lost.
garble.zh: 这条消息在传输中被严重歪曲，原意完全丢失了。

genealogy.en: She spent years tracing the family's genealogy back to a village in the mountains.
genealogy.zh: 她花了数年时间把家谱追溯到山里的一个村庄。

genesis.en: The genesis of the project was a casual conversation between two colleagues at a conference.
genesis.zh: 这个项目的起源，是两位同事在一次会议上的闲谈。

glamorously.en: The advertisement glamorously recast the factory town as a destination for artists.
glamorously.zh: 这则广告把这座工业城市令人向往地包装成艺术家的目的地。

glorify.en: The film does not glorify war; it shows its cost in unflinching detail.
glorify.zh: 这部电影并不美化战争，而是毫不退缩地展现它的代价。

gracious.en: Despite the defeat, she was gracious, congratulating her opponent warmly.
gracious.zh: 尽管失败了，她仍很有风度，热情地向对手表示祝贺。

grandiose.en: The mayor unveiled a grandiose plan to rebuild the entire waterfront in five years.
grandiose.zh: 市长公布了一项宏伟的计划，要在五年内重建整个滨水区。

gratuitous.en: The sequel is full of gratuitous violence that adds nothing to the story.
gratuitous.zh: 这部续集充斥着对情节毫无帮助的多余暴力场面。

grimy.en: The windows of the old factory were grimy with decades of soot.
grimy.zh: 这家老工厂的窗户积满了数十年的烟尘，肮脏不堪。

grouse.en: Commuters groused about the fare increases, but most paid without protest.
grouse.zh: 通勤者对票价上涨怨声载道，但多数人还是默默付了钱。

grudge.en: He held a grudge against the colleague who had taken credit for his idea.
grudge.zh: 他对那位窃取他创意功劳的同事心怀怨恨。

grudging.en: After weeks of resistance, the board gave its grudging approval to the merger.
grudging.zh: 经过数周的抵制，董事会勉强批准了这项合并。

hallucinatory.en: The fever produced hallucinatory visions that seemed more real than the hospital room.
hallucinatory.zh: 高烧产生了幻觉，那些景象看起来比病房还要真实。

hallucinogen.en: The study examines how certain hallucinogens affect perception of time.
hallucinogen.zh: 这项研究考察某些迷幻剂如何影响时间感知。

handicap.en: The team's lack of experience proved a serious handicap in the negotiations.
handicap.zh: 经验不足被证明是这支队伍在谈判中的严重障碍。

harangue.en: The senator delivered a lengthy harangue against the bill, but it passed anyway.
harangue.zh: 这位参议员发表了一篇长篇大论抨击该法案，但法案还是通过了。

harbinger.en: The first swallow is traditionally seen as a harbinger of spring.
harbinger.zh: 传统上，第一只燕子被视为春天的先兆。

hardwired.en: Some fear responses appear to be hardwired in the human brain from birth.
hardwired.zh: 某些恐惧反应似乎是与生俱来、固化在人脑中的。

hardy.en: Only a few hardy shrubs survive the winter on these windswept slopes.
hardy.zh: 在这些狂风肆虐的山坡上，只有少数耐寒的灌木能熬过冬天。

harmonious.en: The choir's harmonious blend of voices filled the cathedral.
harmonious.zh: 唱诗班和谐交融的歌声充满了整座大教堂。

hauteur.en: She answered the reporter's question with icy hauteur and turned away.
hauteur.zh: 她带着冰冷的傲慢回答了记者的问题，然后转过身去。

hearken.en: Hearken to the counsel of those who have walked this path before you.
hearken.zh: 倾听那些曾走过这条路的人的忠告。

hearten.en: The volunteers were heartened by the town's generous response to the flood.
hearten.zh: 小镇对洪灾的慷慨响应让志愿者们深受鼓舞。

hedonism.en: The novel contrasts the hedonism of the capital with the austerity of the provinces.
hedonism.zh: 这部小说把首都的享乐主义与外省的简朴作了对比。

hegemony.en: The small states formed an alliance to resist the empire's growing hegemony.
hegemony.zh: 这些小国结成联盟，以抵抗这个帝国不断扩张的霸权。

hew.en: The report hews closely to the facts and avoids speculation.
hew.zh: 这份报告严格遵循事实，避免推测。

holistic.en: The program takes a holistic approach, treating diet, sleep, and exercise together.
holistic.zh: 该项目采用整体方法，将饮食、睡眠和运动结合起来调理。

honorific.en: In Japanese, honorific forms of verbs are used when speaking of a superior's actions.
honorific.zh: 在日语中，谈及上级的行为时动词要用尊敬形式。

hustler.en: The hustler sold counterfeit tickets outside the stadium to unsuspecting fans.
hustler.zh: 那个骗子在体育场外把假票卖给毫不知情的球迷。

hypostatize.en: The theory risks hypostatizing 'the market' into a being with its own intentions.
hypostatize.zh: 该理论有把'市场'实体化为具有自身意图的存在的风险。

hysteria.en: The rumor sparked a wave of hysteria that emptied the shops within hours.
hysteria.zh: 这则谣言引发了一阵恐慌，商店在几小时内被抢购一空。

idiomatic.en: Her translation captures the idiomatic flavor of the original dialogue.
idiomatic.zh: 她的译文捕捉到了原对话地道的语言风味。

ill-advised.en: The ill-advised decision to cut the research budget cost the company its lead.
ill-advised.zh: 削减研究预算这一不明智的决定，使公司失去了领先优势。

imbue.en: Her teaching imbued students with a lifelong love of poetry.
imbue.zh: 她的教学让学生们对诗歌产生了终身的热爱。

immortal.en: Shakespeare's sonnets have made his beloved all but immortal.
immortal.zh: 莎士比亚的十四行诗几乎让他的爱人获得了不朽。

immovable.en: On the question of principle, the old judge was immovable.
immovable.zh: 在原则问题上，这位老法官立场坚定，毫不动摇。

impalpable.en: A sense of unease, impalpable yet pervasive, hung over the negotiations.
impalpable.zh: 一种难以捉摸却无处不在的不安笼罩着谈判。

imperil.en: A single leak of the encryption keys could imperil the entire network.
imperil.zh: 加密密钥一旦泄露一次，整个网络都会陷入危险。

implicate.en: The documents implicate several senior officials in the cover-up.
implicate.zh: 这些文件牵涉多名高级官员参与了掩盖行动。

impromptu.en: After the ceremony, the graduates held an impromptu concert on the library steps.
impromptu.zh: 仪式结束后，毕业生们在图书馆台阶上举行了一场即兴音乐会。

inaugurate.en: The new treaty inaugurated an era of cooperation between the two rivals.
inaugurate.zh: 这项新条约开启了这两个对手之间合作的时代。

incendiary.en: His incendiary speeches were blamed for inflaming an already tense situation.
incendiary.zh: 他煽动性的演说被指责为加剧了本已紧张的局势。

incite.en: The pamphlet was banned on the grounds that it could incite violence.
incite.zh: 这本小册子因可能煽动暴力而被查禁。

incompetent.en: The inquiry found the bridge collapse had been caused by incompetent maintenance.
incompetent.zh: 调查发现，桥梁倒塌是由不胜任的维护工作造成的。

incongruent.en: The glass tower looks incongruent beside the medieval church.
incongruent.zh: 这座玻璃大厦在中世纪教堂旁边显得格格不入。

incontestable.en: The photograph provides incontestable proof that the meeting took place.
incontestable.zh: 这张照片提供了无可争辩的证据，证明那次会面确实发生过。

incorrigible.en: The incorrigible gambler sold his watch to place one more bet.
incorrigible.zh: 这个屡教不改的赌徒卖掉手表，只为再赌一把。

inculcate.en: The school aims to inculcate respect for evidence in every student.
inculcate.zh: 这所学校致力于向每个学生灌输对证据的尊重。

indefinite.en: The strike was called for an indefinite period, alarming the government.
indefinite.zh: 罢工被宣布为无限期，令政府感到不安。

indisputable.en: It is indisputable that the climate of the region has grown warmer.
indisputable.zh: 该地区气候变暖是毋庸置疑的。

indolent.en: The indolent cat spent the entire afternoon asleep in the sun.
indolent.zh: 那只懒惰的猫整个下午都在阳光下睡觉。

indulgent.en: His indulgent grandparents slipped him sweets whenever his parents looked away.
indulgent.zh: 他溺爱孩子的祖父母趁他父母不注意就塞给他糖果。

ineffable.en: The beauty of the aurora was almost ineffable, defying every attempt at description.
ineffable.zh: 极光之美几乎难以言表，任何描述都显得无力。

inept.en: The inept handling of the crisis turned a minor problem into a major scandal.
inept.zh: 对危机的无能处置把一个小问题变成了一场大丑闻。

infringe.en: The court found that the advertisement infringed the singer's copyright.
infringe.zh: 法院裁定该广告侵犯了这位歌手的版权。

infuriate.en: The editor's constant interruptions infuriated the normally calm author.
infuriate.zh: 编辑不停的打断把一向温和的作家激怒了。

inquire.en: Visitors often inquire whether the castle is open to the public in winter.
inquire.zh: 游客常询问这座城堡冬季是否向公众开放。

insincere.en: His apology sounded insincere, recited without a trace of genuine regret.
insincere.zh: 他的道歉听起来毫无诚意，像是在背诵，没有一丝真正的悔意。

inspirational.en: Her speech about rebuilding the town was genuinely inspirational.
inspirational.zh: 她关于重建小镇的演讲真正鼓舞人心。

interlope.en: The strangers were accused of interloping on land reserved for the tribe.
interlope.zh: 这些陌生人被指控擅闯为部落保留的土地。

intermediary.en: The diplomat acted as an intermediary between the two warring factions.
intermediary.zh: 这位外交官在两个交战派系之间担任调停人。

interrogate.en: The detective interrogated the suspect for six hours before releasing him.
interrogate.zh: 警探审问了嫌疑人六个小时才将他释放。

introspective.en: Her later poems are quieter and more introspective than her early work.
introspective.zh: 她后期的诗比早期作品更安静、更内省。

inundation.en: The inundation of the valley after the dam burst displaced thousands.
inundation.zh: 大坝决堤后山谷被洪水淹没，数千人流离失所。

invert.en: The photograph was printed with the colors inverted, turning day into night.
invert.zh: 这张照片洗印时颜色被颠倒了，白昼变成了黑夜。

invigorate.en: A week in the mountains invigorated her more than any medicine could have.
invigorate.zh: 在山里住了一个星期，比任何药物都更让她精神振奋。

irresolute.en: The irresolute committee postponed the decision for the third consecutive month.
irresolute.zh: 优柔寡断的委员会连续第三个月推迟了决定。

irreversible.en: Scientists warn that the melting of the ice sheet may soon become irreversible.
irreversible.zh: 科学家警告说，冰盖的融化可能很快变得不可逆转。

irritate.en: The seam of the shirt irritated his skin throughout the long flight.
irritate.zh: 衬衫的接缝在漫长的飞行中一直磨得他皮肤难受。

jade.en: Years of luxury had jaded his appetite for even the finest cuisine.
jade.zh: 多年的奢华生活让他对最精致的美食也感到厌烦。

jeopardize.en: Speaking to the press now could jeopardize the entire investigation.
jeopardize.zh: 现在对媒体发言可能会危及整个调查。

jovial.en: The jovial innkeeper kept his guests laughing well past midnight.
jovial.zh: 这位快活的旅店老板让客人们笑到半夜之后。

juxtapose.en: The exhibition juxtaposes photographs of the city taken a century apart.
juxtapose.zh: 展览将相隔一百年拍摄的这座城市照片并置在一起。

labile.en: The patient's labile blood pressure required constant monitoring.
labile.zh: 病人不稳定的血压需要持续监测。

lacuna.en: The discovery of the letters fills a major lacuna in the poet's biography.
lacuna.zh: 这些书信的发现填补了这位诗人传记中的一个重大空白。

lavish.en: The embassy hosted a lavish reception for the visiting delegation.
lavish.zh: 大使馆为来访代表团举办了盛大的招待会。

lawlike.en: Physicists search for lawlike regularities that hold across all observed galaxies.
lawlike.zh: 物理学家寻找在所有已观测星系中都成立的类似定律的规律。

legendary.en: The legendary goalkeeper played twenty seasons for the same club.
legendary.zh: 这位传奇门将为同一家俱乐部效力了二十个赛季。

linchpin.en: The port is the linchpin of the region's entire economy.
linchpin.zh: 这座港口是整个地区经济的关键支柱。

loophole.en: The company exploited a loophole in the tax code to avoid millions in payments.
loophole.zh: 这家公司利用税法中的一个漏洞，避缴了数百万税款。

lowbrow.en: The critic dismissed the series as lowbrow entertainment unworthy of review.
lowbrow.zh: 评论家把这部剧斥为不值一评的低俗娱乐。

macabre.en: The museum's macabre collection includes masks used in medieval plague rituals.
macabre.zh: 这座博物馆阴森可怖的藏品包括中世纪瘟疫仪式中使用的面具。

magnify.en: The lens magnifies the specimen two hundred times without distortion.
magnify.zh: 这枚透镜能把标本放大二百倍而不失真。

maladroit.en: His maladroit handling of the press conference turned a small error into a scandal.
maladroit.zh: 他对新闻发布会的笨拙应对，把一个小错误变成了一场丑闻。

malcontent.en: A small group of malcontents blocked every reform the council proposed.
malcontent.zh: 一小撮心怀不满者阻挠了议会提出的每一项改革。

malice.en: The letter was written with such malice that she burned it without finishing it.
malice.zh: 这封信充满恶意，她没读完就把它烧掉了。

malinger.en: The sergeant suspected the recruit was malingering to avoid the morning drills.
malinger.zh: 中士怀疑这名新兵装病以逃避早操。

malodor.en: A malodor from the drains hung over the old quarter after the rains.
malodor.zh: 雨后，一股来自下水道的恶臭笼罩着老城区。

mercenary.en: The mercenary motives behind the charity gala were soon exposed.
mercenary.zh: 这场慈善晚会背后唯利是图的动机很快就被揭露了。

meritocracy.en: The exam system was designed as a meritocracy, open to candidates of every background.
meritocracy.zh: 该考试制度被设计为任人唯贤的体系，向各种背景的考生开放。

methodical.en: Her methodical review of the archives uncovered documents everyone else had overlooked.
methodical.zh: 她对档案馆有条不紊的查阅，发现了其他人都忽略的文件。

middlebrow.en: The magazine caters to middlebrow tastes, mixing celebrity profiles with light essays.
middlebrow.zh: 这本杂志迎合中等品位，把名人专访和轻松的随笔混在一起。

minion.en: The general's minions carried out his orders without question.
minion.zh: 将军的手下不加质疑地执行他的命令。

minutia.en: The lawyer mastered every minutia of the thousand-page contract.
minutia.zh: 这位律师掌握了这份上千页合同的每一个细节。

mirthful.en: The mirthful atmosphere of the harvest festival lasted well into the night.
mirthful.zh: 丰收节的欢乐气氛一直持续到深夜。

misapplied.en: The funds were misapplied, spent on banquets rather than books.
misapplied.zh: 这笔资金被误用了，花在了宴席而不是书籍上。

misgive.en: His confident tone did not misgive the doubts he felt in private.
misgive.zh: 他自信的语气掩盖了他私下的疑虑。

mnemonic.en: Every medical student learns the mnemonic for the cranial nerves.
mnemonic.zh: 每个医学生都学过记忆脑神经的口诀。

moderation.en: The doctor advised moderation in all things, including exercise.
moderation.zh: 医生建议凡事适度，包括运动。

modular.en: The new housing is modular, allowing units to be added as families grow.
modular.zh: 这种新住宅是模块化的，可以随着家庭扩大而增加单元。

momentous.en: The signing of the treaty was a momentous occasion in the nation's history.
momentous.zh: 条约的签署是该国历史上的一个重大时刻。

monarchist.en: The monarchist party campaigned for the restoration of the exiled king.
monarchist.zh: 君主主义政党为恢复流亡国王的王位而奔走。

monger.en: The rumor-mongers of the court destroyed more careers than any war.
monger.zh: 宫廷里造谣生事的人毁掉的前程比任何战争都多。

monotonous.en: The monotonous hum of the machinery made it hard to stay alert.
monotonous.zh: 机器单调的嗡嗡声让人很难保持清醒。

moot.en: Whether the plan would have worked is now moot; the funding has been withdrawn.
moot.zh: 这个计划是否可行已无实际意义——资金已被撤回。

moralistic.en: The novel avoids moralistic judgment, presenting each character's choices without condemnation.
moralistic.zh: 这部小说避免说教式的评判，不加谴责地呈现每个角色的选择。

morph.en: Over the decade, the small workshop morphed into a global manufacturer.
morph.zh: 十年间，这家小作坊变成了一家全球制造商。

mouthpiece.en: The newspaper served as a mouthpiece for the ruling party throughout the crisis.
mouthpiece.zh: 在整个危机期间，这家报纸都是执政党的喉舌。

multifarious.en: The museum's multifarious collection ranges from fossils to fax machines.
multifarious.zh: 这座博物馆五花八门的藏品从化石到传真机应有尽有。

munificent.en: An anonymous donor made a munificent gift that saved the library from closure.
munificent.zh: 一位匿名捐赠者的慷慨捐赠使这家图书馆免于关闭。

nadir.en: The team's defeat in the final marked the nadir of a once-great dynasty.
nadir.zh: 球队在决赛中的失利，标志着一个曾经辉煌的王朝跌入谷底。

natter.en: The two neighbors would natter over the fence for hours about nothing in particular.
natter.zh: 这两位邻居会隔着篱笆唠叨上好几个小时，东拉西扯。

nepotism.en: The appointment of the minister's son was widely criticized as blatant nepotism.
nepotism.zh: 任命部长的儿子被广泛批评为明目张胆的裙带关系。

nihilism.en: The novel's protagonist drifts into nihilism after losing everything he valued.
nihilism.zh: 小说的主人公在失去珍视的一切之后陷入了虚无主义。

nod.en: The auctioneer accepted her nod as a bid of ten thousand.
nod.zh: 拍卖师把她的点头视为一万的出价。

nonplus.en: The sudden question nonplussed the witness, who had expected only routine inquiries.
nonplus.zh: 这个突如其来的问题让证人不知所措，他原以为只有例行询问。

notorious.en: The crossroads is notorious for accidents, especially in winter fog.
notorious.zh: 这个十字路口以事故频发闻名，尤其是在冬季大雾中。

obsess.en: The detective obsessed over the unsolved case long after his retirement.
obsess.zh: 这位警探退休后很久仍对那桩悬案念念不忘。

opulence.en: The palace's opulence shocked visitors accustomed to the king's austere reputation.
opulence.zh: 宫殿的奢华让习惯了国王简朴名声的访客们大为震惊。

outlandish.en: The designer's outlandish hats were the talk of the fashion show.
outlandish.zh: 这位设计师稀奇古怪的帽子成了时装秀的话题。

overblow.en: The tabloids overblew the incident into a scandal of national proportions.
overblow.zh: 小报把这件事夸大成了一场全国性的丑闻。

overclaim.en: The advertisement overclaims the benefits of the supplement beyond any evidence.
overclaim.zh: 这则广告对该补充剂功效的宣传超出了任何证据所能支持的程度。

overdue.en: The library finally recovered a book that was forty years overdue.
overdue.zh: 图书馆终于收回了一本逾期四十年的书。

overreach.en: The general overreached, extending his supply lines until they broke.
overreach.zh: 这位将军野心过大，把补给线拉到断裂的地步。

paean.en: The poem is a paean to the quiet heroism of ordinary nurses.
paean.zh: 这首诗是对普通护士默默奉献的英雄主义的赞歌。

palaver.en: After an hour of palaver, the committee had decided nothing at all.
palaver.zh: 空谈了一个小时后，委员会什么也没决定下来。

paramount.en: Safety is paramount in every decision the airline makes.
paramount.zh: 安全是这家航空公司每一个决策中的首要考虑。

parley.en: The two generals agreed to parley under a flag of truce.
parley.zh: 两位将军同意在休战旗下谈判。

paroxysm.en: The announcement sent the crowd into a paroxysm of joy.
paroxysm.zh: 这则公告让人群爆发出一阵狂喜。

parsimony.en: His legendary parsimony extended to reusing tea bags and writing on envelope backs.
parsimony.zh: 他出了名的吝啬，连茶包都要重复用，信写在信封背面。

partition.en: The partition of the estate among the heirs took years of legal wrangling.
partition.zh: 遗产在继承人之间的分割耗费了多年的法律争执。

pathological.en: His pathological fear of germs kept him from leaving the house for months.
pathological.zh: 他对细菌的极端恐惧让他数月不敢出门。

peevish.en: The peevish reviewer seemed determined to dislike everything about the film.
peevish.zh: 这位易怒的评论家似乎打定主意要讨厌这部电影的一切。

peregrination.en: Her peregrinations across Asia filled a dozen notebooks with sketches.
peregrination.zh: 她在亚洲的漫游画满了十几本速写。

peremptory.en: The judge issued a peremptory order that ended the debate in the courtroom.
peremptory.zh: 法官发布了一道不容反抗的命令，终结了法庭上的争论。

permissiveness.en: Critics blamed the school's permissiveness for the decline in discipline.
permissiveness.zh: 批评者把纪律的滑坡归咎于学校的放任。

pertinacious.en: Her pertinacious questioning eventually forced the minister to admit the error.
pertinacious.zh: 她锲而不舍的追问最终迫使部长承认了错误。

perverse.en: It seems perverse to cut the arts budget while subsidizing stadiums.
perverse.zh: 削减艺术预算却补贴体育场馆，这似乎很荒谬。

philistine.en: He called the council philistines for voting to demolish the old theater.
philistine.zh: 他称投票决定拆除老剧院的议员们为庸俗之辈。

phlegmatic.en: The phlegmatic captain remained calm even as the storm tore the sails.
phlegmatic.zh: 即使风暴撕破了船帆，这位沉着的船长依然镇定自若。

pillage.en: The invading army pillaged the monasteries, carrying off centuries of manuscripts.
pillage.zh: 入侵的军队洗劫了修道院，掳走了数百年的手稿。

pinnacle.en: Winning the championship was the pinnacle of her long career.
pinnacle.zh: 赢得冠军是她漫长职业生涯的巅峰。

placid.en: The placid surface of the lake gave no hint of the currents below.
placid.zh: 湖面平静无波，看不出水下的暗流。

plod.en: The caravan plodded across the desert for forty days.
plod.zh: 商队在沙漠中缓慢跋涉了四十天。

pluralistic.en: The constitution guarantees a pluralistic society in which many traditions coexist.
pluralistic.zh: 宪法保障一个多元社会，多种传统在其中共存。

poignant.en: The photograph of the empty classroom was a poignant reminder of the village's decline.
poignant.zh: 那张空荡荡教室的照片，是这座村庄衰落的令人心酸的写照。

polarity.en: The polarity between the two parties has made compromise almost impossible.
polarity.zh: 两党之间的两极对立使妥协几乎不可能。

pompous.en: The pompous official insisted on being addressed by his full title at all times.
pompous.zh: 那位自命不凡的官员坚持别人在任何时候都用全称头衔称呼他。

popularize.en: The documentary did more to popularize marine biology than any textbook.
popularize.zh: 这部纪录片对普及海洋生物学的作用超过任何教科书。

populism.en: The candidate's rise was fueled by a wave of populism sweeping the countryside.
populism.zh: 这位候选人的崛起得益于席卷乡村的民粹主义浪潮。

portent.en: The eclipse was taken as a portent of the dynasty's coming fall.
portent.zh: 这次日食被视为王朝即将覆灭的预兆。

poseur.en: The gallery crowd quickly saw through the poseur who misquoted every artist he praised.
poseur.zh: 画廊里的人群很快看穿了那个装腔作势的人——他提到的每位艺术家都被他引错了。

predicate.en: The entire argument is predicated on the assumption that growth will continue.
predicate.zh: 整个论证都建立在增长将持续这一假设之上。

predispose.en: A childhood spent near the sea predisposed her to love sailing.
predispose.zh: 在海边度过的童年使她天生热爱航海。

preordain.en: Nothing about the experiment's outcome was preordained; failure was a real possibility.
preordain.zh: 实验的结果没有任何预先注定之处，失败的可能性真实存在。

prepossessing.en: The prepossessing smile of the young ambassador won over even the skeptics.
prepossessing.zh: 年轻大使富有感染力的微笑，连怀疑者也被争取了过来。

prescience.en: Her prescience about the housing crash made her reputation on Wall Street.
prescience.zh: 她对房地产崩盘的先见之明，让她在华尔街声名鹊起。

presumptuous.en: It would be presumptuous of me to speak for the whole committee.
presumptuous.zh: 要我代表整个委员会发言，那就太冒昧了。

privation.en: The memoir recounts the privations of a childhood spent in wartime.
privation.zh: 这本回忆录讲述了在战时度过的童年所经历的匮乏。

procure.en: The museum procured the manuscript at auction for a record price.
procure.zh: 博物馆在拍卖会上以创纪录的价格购得了这份手稿。

profit-monger.en: The reformers denounced the profit-mongers who had bought up the city's water supply.
profit-monger.zh: 改革者们谴责那些买下城市供水系统的贪婪商人。

profuse.en: The garden was a profuse tangle of roses, jasmine, and wild mint.
profuse.zh: 这座花园是玫瑰、茉莉和野薄荷繁茂交织的天地。

promulgate.en: The agency promulgated new rules for the labeling of genetically modified foods.
promulgate.zh: 该机构颁布了转基因食品标识的新规定。

propaganda.en: The regime's propaganda portrayed every defeat as a strategic withdrawal.
propaganda.zh: 该政权的宣传把每一次失败都说成是战略撤退。

propel.en: The discovery propelled the young researcher to international fame.
propel.zh: 这项发现把这位年轻的研究者推向了国际声誉。

prophet.en: The self-styled prophet warned of floods that never came.
prophet.zh: 这位自称的预言家预言的洪水从未到来。

prophylactic.en: Vaccination remains the most effective prophylactic against the disease.
prophylactic.zh: 接种疫苗仍是预防该疾病最有效的措施。

proselytize.en: The missionaries traveled south to proselytize among the villages.
proselytize.zh: 传教士们南下到各村去传教。

provisional.en: The provisional government ruled for eighteen months before elections were held.
provisional.zh: 临时政府执政了十八个月，随后举行了选举。

puerile.en: The debate collapsed into puerile name-calling unworthy of the chamber.
puerile.zh: 辩论沦为幼稚的相互谩骂，与议事厅的尊严不相称。

puffery.en: The label's claim to be 'the world's finest coffee' is legal puffery, not a fact.
puffery.zh: 标签上'世界最佳咖啡'的说法是合法的夸大宣传，而非事实。

purge.en: The new director purged the department of everyone associated with the old regime.
purge.zh: 新主任把部门里所有与旧政权有关联的人都清洗了出去。

quackery.en: The magazine exposed the clinic's treatments as expensive quackery.
quackery.zh: 这家杂志揭露了该诊所的疗法不过是昂贵的江湖骗术。

quaint.en: The village, with its thatched roofs and single shop, was charmingly quaint.
quaint.zh: 这座村庄有茅草屋顶和唯一的一家小店，古雅得可爱。

querulous.en: The querulous passenger complained about every aspect of the journey.
querulous.zh: 这位爱发牢骚的乘客对旅程的每个方面都抱怨不休。

quiver.en: Her voice began to quiver as she read the last page of the letter.
quiver.zh: 读信读到最后一页时，她的声音开始颤抖。

rapt.en: The audience sat rapt as the violinist played the final movement.
rapt.zh: 小提琴家演奏最后一个乐章时，观众们全神贯注地坐着。

rapturous.en: The premiere received a rapturous ovation lasting ten minutes.
rapturous.zh: 首演获得了长达十分钟的狂喜喝彩。

ratified.en: The treaty, once ratified, bound both nations for fifty years.
ratified.zh: 该条约一经批准，便约束两国五十年。

ratify.en: The senate voted overwhelmingly to ratify the trade agreement.
ratify.zh: 参议院以压倒性多数投票批准了这项贸易协定。

recap.en: Before the vote, the chair recapped the main arguments on both sides.
recap.zh: 表决前，主席扼要重述了双方的主要论点。

recapitulation.en: The final chapter is a recapitulation of the book's central claims.
recapitulation.zh: 最后一章是对全书核心论点的概括重述。

recluse.en: The novelist became a recluse, refusing all interviews for thirty years.
recluse.zh: 这位小说家成了隐士，三十年拒绝一切采访。

recollect.en: She could not recollect where she had left the keys.
recollect.zh: 她想不起把钥匙放在哪里了。

recrudesce.en: The old feud recrudesced whenever the two families met.
recrudesce.zh: 每当两个家族见面，旧怨就会复发。

recurrence.en: Doctors monitored the patient closely for any recurrence of the infection.
recurrence.zh: 医生密切监测病人，以防感染的任何复发。

redeem.en: One brilliant final chapter redeems the otherwise mediocre novel.
redeem.zh: 一个精彩的结尾章节挽救了这本原本平庸的小说。

redolent.en: The kitchen was redolent of cinnamon and baking bread.
redolent.zh: 厨房里弥漫着肉桂和烤面包的芬芳。

redress.en: The fund was established to redress decades of underinvestment in the region.
redress.zh: 设立该基金是为了纠正该地区数十年来投资不足的问题。

regrettable.en: The loss of the manuscripts was a regrettable consequence of the fire.
regrettable.zh: 手稿的损毁是那场火灾令人惋惜的后果。

reiteration.en: His constant reiteration of the same point wore down the audience.
reiteration.zh: 他对同一个论点没完没了的重复让听众感到厌烦。

remonstrate.en: The delegates remonstrated with the chair over the unfair voting procedure.
remonstrate.zh: 代表们就不公平的投票程序向主席提出抗议。

renounce.en: The prince renounced his claim to the throne and became a monk.
renounce.zh: 王子宣布放弃王位继承权，出家为僧。

repel.en: The fortress walls repelled every assault the invaders launched.
repel.zh: 要塞的城墙击退了入侵者发动的每一次进攻。

reprisal.en: The bombing was carried out in reprisal for the earlier attack on the convoy.
reprisal.zh: 这次轰炸是对早些时候车队遇袭的报复。

reputable.en: Always buy insurance from a reputable company with a long track record.
reputable.zh: 一定要从业绩记录良好的信誉公司购买保险。

requiem.en: The choir performed a requiem for the victims of the earthquake.
requiem.zh: 唱诗班为地震遇难者演奏了安魂曲。

rescind.en: The council voted to rescind the controversial parking ordinance.
rescind.zh: 市议会投票撤销了那项有争议的停车条例。

resent.en: She resented being passed over for the promotion she had earned.
resent.zh: 她对错失自己应得的晋升机会心怀怨恨。

retention.en: The retention of experienced staff became the company's top priority.
retention.zh: 留住经验丰富的员工成了公司的头等大事。

retort.en: When accused of laziness, he retorted that he had built the company from nothing.
retort.zh: 当被指责懒惰时，他反驳说这家公司是他白手起家创建的。

retraction.en: The newspaper printed a full retraction after the story was proven false.
retraction.zh: 在报道被证实为虚假之后，该报刊登了全面的更正声明。

retrenchment.en: The merger was followed by a period of retrenchment and layoffs.
retrenchment.zh: 合并之后是一段紧缩和裁员的时期。

revere.en: The villagers revere the old doctor who served them for fifty years.
revere.zh: 村民们尊崇那位为他们服务了五十年的老医生。

riposte.en: Her witty riposte silenced the heckler and delighted the audience.
riposte.zh: 她机智的反驳让起哄者哑口无言，令观众大为欣喜。

rive.en: The earthquake rived the valley floor, opening fissures a meter wide.
rive.zh: 地震撕裂了谷底，裂开了一米宽的缝隙。

rote.en: The students memorized the formulas by rote without understanding them.
rote.zh: 学生们死记硬背这些公式，却并不理解。

salacious.en: The tabloid's salacious headlines bore little relation to the facts.
salacious.zh: 小报那些淫秽耸动的标题与事实相去甚远。

salvational.en: The refugees saw the rescue ships as a salvational force sent from nowhere.
salvational.zh: 难民们把救援船视为从天而降的拯救力量。

sangfroid.en: The pilot's sangfroid during the emergency landing saved everyone aboard.
sangfroid.zh: 飞行员在紧急迫降时的镇定挽救了机上所有人。

sanitize.en: The report was sanitized before release, with all names removed.
sanitize.zh: 报告在发布前经过了净化处理，所有人名都被删除。

sapiential.en: The anthology gathers the sapiential literature of three ancient traditions.
sapiential.zh: 这部选集汇集了三个古老传统的智慧文学。

scarred.en: The landscape, scarred by decades of mining, is slowly being restored.
scarred.zh: 这片被数十年采矿破坏得伤痕累累的土地，正在缓慢修复。

scornful.en: She was scornful of any theory that had not been tested against data.
scornful.zh: 她对任何未经数据检验的理论都嗤之以鼻。

scotch.en: The company issued a statement to scotch rumors of an imminent takeover.
scotch.zh: 公司发表声明，平息即将被收购的传言。

scourge.en: Corruption remains the scourge of the region's public institutions.
scourge.zh: 腐败仍是该地区公共机构的祸根。

scruple.en: He had no scruples about selling defective parts to the navy.
scruple.zh: 他向海军出售劣质零件，毫无顾忌。

secession.en: The province's secession triggered a constitutional crisis.
secession.zh: 该省的脱离引发了一场宪法危机。

seclusion.en: After the trial, she lived in seclusion on a remote island.
seclusion.zh: 审判之后，她在一座偏远的小岛上过着隐居生活。

sectarian.en: The conflict took on a sectarian character that divided neighborhoods.
sectarian.zh: 这场冲突带上了派系色彩，使各个社区分裂。

sedulous.en: Her sedulous care brought the neglected garden back to life.
sedulous.zh: 她孜孜不倦的照料让这座荒废的花园重获生机。

seemly.en: In that era, it was not considered seemly for women to speak in public.
seemly.zh: 在那个时代，女性公开讲话被认为是不合宜的。

self-defeating.en: Constantly checking the score became a self-defeating distraction from the work itself.
self-defeating.zh: 不停地查看分数成了一种适得其反的干扰，使人无法专注于工作本身。

semblance.en: After the coup, the general maintained a semblance of constitutional order.
semblance.zh: 政变之后，这位将军维持着宪法秩序的表象。

sensationalized.en: The trial was so sensationalized by the press that a fair jury became impossible.
sensationalized.zh: 审判被媒体大肆渲染，以至于公正的陪审团已不可能组成。

serendipitous.en: Their serendipitous meeting at the airport led to a lifelong collaboration.
serendipitous.zh: 他们在机场偶然的相遇，促成了终身的合作。

shady.en: They rested in the shady courtyard during the hottest hours of the day.
shady.zh: 一天中最热的时辰，他们在成荫的庭院里休息。

simmer.en: Resentment simmered in the department after the unfair promotions.
simmer.zh: 不公平的晋升之后，怨恨在部门里暗暗积聚。

simplify.en: The new software simplifies the entire filing process.
simplify.zh: 新软件简化了整个申报流程。

snob.en: He was a snob about wine, refusing to drink anything under a hundred dollars.
snob.zh: 他在葡萄酒上很势利，一百美元以下的酒一概不喝。

snobbish.en: Her snobbish remarks about the neighborhood offended half the guests.
snobbish.zh: 她对这个街区的势利评论冒犯了一半的客人。

snooper.en: The scandal began when a snooper photographed the minister's private letters.
snooper.zh: 丑闻始于一名刺探者偷拍了部长的私人信件。

solidify.en: The alliance solidified after the two leaders signed the defense pact.
solidify.zh: 两位领导人签署防务条约后，联盟得到了巩固。

solipsistic.en: The essay was criticized as solipsistic, acknowledging no perspective but the author's own.
solipsistic.zh: 这篇文章被批评为唯我论，除了作者自己的视角外不承认任何其他视角。

sovereign.en: The sovereign authority of the parliament was established by the constitution.
sovereign.zh: 议会的最高权力由宪法确立。

spacious.en: The new library is spacious, with reading rooms overlooking the river.
spacious.zh: 新图书馆很宽敞，阅览室可以俯瞰河面。

spike.en: Demand for masks spiked during the first weeks of the outbreak.
spike.zh: 疫情暴发的最初几周，口罩需求骤升。

staggering.en: The cost of the project reached a staggering two billion dollars.
staggering.zh: 这个项目的成本达到了惊人的二十亿美元。

standardize.en: The industry agreed to standardize charging ports across all devices.
standardize.zh: 行业同意将所有设备的充电接口标准化。

sticky.en: The negotiations reached a sticky point over the sharing of water rights.
sticky.zh: 谈判在水资源分配问题上陷入了棘手的僵局。

stipulate.en: The lease stipulates that tenants may not keep pets.
stipulate.zh: 租约规定租户不得饲养宠物。

stodgy.en: The stodgy old bank was slow to adopt digital services.
stodgy.zh: 这家守旧的老银行在采用数字服务方面行动迟缓。

stoic.en: She remained stoic throughout the long illness, never complaining.
stoic.zh: 在漫长的病痛中，她始终坚忍，从不抱怨。

stoicism.en: His stoicism in the face of defeat earned him the respect of his rivals.
stoicism.zh: 他面对失败的坚忍赢得了对手的尊重。

stratify.en: The survey stratifies respondents by age, income, and region.
stratify.zh: 这项调查按年龄、收入和地区对受访者进行分层。

subservient.en: The press in that country is subservient to the ruling party.
subservient.zh: 那个国家的新闻界屈从于执政党。

subsume.en: The new category subsumes several older classifications under one heading.
subsume.zh: 这个新类别把几个旧的分类归入同一名目之下。

supercilious.en: The supercilious waiter looked down on customers who mispronounced the dishes.
supercilious.zh: 那位傲慢的服务生看不起念错菜名的顾客。

surmount.en: She surmounted every obstacle on her path to the presidency.
surmount.zh: 她克服了通往总统之路上的每一道障碍。

suspense.en: The novel sustains its suspense until the very last page.
suspense.zh: 这部小说把悬念一直保持到最后一页。

sybaritic.en: The sybaritic lifestyle of the court shocked the austere reformers.
sybaritic.zh: 宫廷贪图享乐的生活方式令崇尚简朴的改革者们震惊。

sycophant.en: The dictator surrounded himself with sycophants who praised his every word.
sycophant.zh: 独裁者身边围满了对他的每句话都赞不绝口的马屁精。

symbiosis.en: The symbiosis between the university and the city benefits both.
symbiosis.zh: 大学与城市之间的共生关系使双方受益。

synergy.en: The merger created a synergy that neither company could achieve alone.
synergy.zh: 合并创造了任何一家公司单独都无法实现的协同效应。

tacit.en: There was a tacit agreement among the staff never to mention the incident.
tacit.zh: 员工之间有一种心照不宣的默契：绝不提起那件事。

tactful.en: Her tactful suggestion avoided embarrassing anyone at the meeting.
tactful.zh: 她得体的建议避免了让会上任何人难堪。

tamper.en: Someone had tampered with the evidence before the police arrived.
tamper.zh: 警方到达之前，有人篡改了证据。

tantalizing.en: The menu offered a tantalizing glimpse of the chef's imagination.
tantalizing.zh: 菜单让人垂涎地窥见了主厨的想象力。

thoroughgoing.en: The report calls for a thoroughgoing reform of the tax system.
thoroughgoing.zh: 报告呼吁对税收制度进行彻底的改革。

thrall.en: The kingdom fell into the thrall of a charismatic but ruthless minister.
thrall.zh: 这个王国落入了一位有魅力却无情的大臣的掌控之中。

topical.en: The comedian's topical jokes drew laughter and groans in equal measure.
topical.zh: 这位喜剧演员关于时事的笑话引来了笑声和嘘声各半。

totem.en: The eagle served as a totem for the tribe's warriors.

travesty.en: The trial was denounced as a travesty of justice by observers around the world.
travesty.zh: 世界各地的观察家谴责这次审判是对司法的嘲弄。

treacherous.en: The treacherous mountain pass claimed several lives every winter.
treacherous.zh: 这条险恶的山道每年冬天都要夺走几条人命。

triangulates.en: The survey triangulates the fortress's position from three hilltops.
triangulates.zh: 测量从三座山头把要塞的位置三角定位。

trifle.en: Do not dismiss the error as a trifle; it could invalidate the whole study.
trifle.zh: 不要把这个错误当作小事——它可能使整个研究失效。

trite.en: The speech was full of trite phrases that moved no one.
trite.zh: 这篇演说满是陈词滥调，打动不了任何人。

trope.en: The haunted house is a familiar trope of Gothic fiction.
trope.zh: 鬼屋是哥特小说中常见的比喻手法。

unanimity.en: The proposal passed with rare unanimity, without a single dissenting vote.
unanimity.zh: 该提案以罕见的一致同意通过，没有一张反对票。

uncomely.en: The uncomely concrete block replaced a beloved Victorian theater.
uncomely.zh: 那座难看的混凝土大楼取代了一座深受喜爱的维多利亚式剧院。

unconvincing.en: The witness's unconvincing account changed several times under questioning.
unconvincing.zh: 证人难以令人信服的陈述在质询下改口了好几次。

unctuous.en: His unctuous compliments made everyone at the table uncomfortable.
unctuous.zh: 他谄媚的恭维让桌上的每个人都不自在。

undergird.zh: 信任支撑着每一段成功的伙伴关系。

undetectable.en: The poison was virtually undetectable by the methods of the time.
undetectable.zh: 这种毒药用当时的方法几乎无法检测出来。

undifferentiated.en: The proposals remained an undifferentiated mass of good intentions.
undifferentiated.zh: 这些提议仍是一团无法区分彼此的善意。

undiscriminating.en: The undiscriminating reader swallowed every rumor the site published.
undiscriminating.zh: 不加辨别的读者把该网站发布的每则谣言都信以为真。

unease.en: A growing unease about the project's safety spread through the team.
unease.zh: 对项目安全性的担忧在团队中蔓延开来。

unesteemed.en: The poet died unesteemed, her genius recognized only decades later.
unesteemed.zh: 这位诗人去世时不为人知，她的天才数十年后才被承认。

unethical.en: Selling patient data without consent is plainly unethical.
unethical.zh: 未经同意出售患者数据显然是不道德的。

unexploited.en: Vast reserves of geothermal energy remain unexploited in the region.
unexploited.zh: 该地区大量的地热能储量尚未开发。

unfeasible.en: Building a bridge at that location proved unfeasible given the currents.
unfeasible.zh: 鉴于水流情况，在该位置建桥被证明不可行。

unify.en: The treaty unified the two kingdoms under a single crown.
unify.zh: 该条约把两个王国统一在同一顶王冠之下。

unimaginative.en: The sequel was dismissed as an unimaginative rehash of the original.
unimaginative.zh: 这部续集被斥为对原作缺乏想象力的翻炒。

universality.en: The declaration asserts the universality of human rights.
universality.zh: 该宣言主张人权的普遍性。

unnerving.en: The silence in the abandoned hospital was unnerving.
unnerving.zh: 废弃医院里的寂静令人毛骨悚然。

unobservant.en: He was too unobservant to notice the warning signs all around him.
unobservant.zh: 他太不留心了，没有注意到四周的警示信号。

unobtainable.en: Fresh vegetables were almost unobtainable during the blockade.
unobtainable.zh: 封锁期间，新鲜蔬菜几乎不可能买到。

unparalleled.en: The museum houses an unparalleled collection of Ming porcelain.
unparalleled.zh: 这座博物馆收藏着无与伦比的明代瓷器。

unpropitious.en: The expedition set out under unpropitious skies, with storms forecast.
unpropitious.zh: 探险队在不利的天象下出发，预报有风暴。

unrivaled.en: Her knowledge of medieval manuscripts is unrivaled in the field.
unrivaled.zh: 她对中世纪手稿的了解在该领域无可匹敌。

unsentimental.en: The biography is refreshingly unsentimental about its famous subject.
unsentimental.zh: 这本传记对这位著名传主的叙述理智得令人耳目一新。

unstinting.en: Her unstinting generosity supported dozens of young scholars.
unstinting.zh: 她慷慨无保留的资助支持了数十名年轻学者。

unwavering.en: His unwavering commitment to the truth cost him his job but won him history's respect.
unwavering.zh: 他对真相坚定不移的坚守让他丢了工作，却赢得了历史的尊重。

unwonted.en: The unwonted heat of the summer withered the northern crops.
unwonted.zh: 那个夏天异常的高温使北方的庄稼枯萎了。

uphold.en: The court upheld the lower court's ruling on the land dispute.
uphold.zh: 法院维持了下级法院对土地纠纷的裁决。

usurp.en: The general usurped the throne while the king was abroad.
usurp.zh: 国王在国外时，将军篡夺了王位。

vainglory.en: His vainglory led him to claim credit for victories he never won.
vainglory.zh: 他的虚荣使他把自己从未赢得的胜利据为己有。

vandalize.en: The statues in the park were vandalized during the riots.
vandalize.zh: 公园里的雕像在骚乱中被人为破坏。

vexed.en: The committee returned to the vexed question of water rights.
vexed.zh: 委员会又回到了水资源权这个棘手的问题上。

virtuosity.en: The pianist's virtuosity left the audience breathless.
virtuosity.zh: 钢琴家精湛的技艺令观众屏息。

vituperate.en: The editorial vituperated against the policy in the harshest terms.
vituperate.zh: 社论以最严厉的措辞抨击了这项政策。

vulgar.en: The critic dismissed the novel as a vulgar appeal to popular taste.
vulgar.zh: 评论家把这部小说斥为对大众口味的粗俗迎合。

waive.en: The bank agreed to waive the fees for long-standing customers.
waive.zh: 银行同意免除老客户的费用。

wart.en: The report describes the plan honestly, warts and all.
wart.zh: 报告如实地描述了这个计划，包括它所有的缺点。

windfall.en: The inheritance was an unexpected windfall that allowed her to retire early.
windfall.zh: 这笔遗产是一笔意外之财，让她得以提前退休。

winsome.en: Her winsome smile made her the most photographed athlete at the games.
winsome.zh: 她迷人的微笑使她成为运动会上被拍得最多的运动员。

worrisome.en: The worrisome rise in cases prompted new restrictions.
worrisome.zh: 病例令人担忧的上升促使当局出台了新的限制措施。

wrangle.en: The lawyers wrangled for hours over a single clause.
wrangle.zh: 律师们为一个条款争论了好几个小时。

wretched.en: The refugees lived in wretched conditions in the overcrowded camp.
wretched.zh: 难民们在拥挤不堪的营地里过着悲惨的生活。
